purpose: Record source-context field extraction for all C2-LT-B3 neuro-sensory-cognitive domain-source tasks while preserving source-lineage mismatches, access limitations, transfer boundaries, downgrade triggers and model-admission blocks.

currentLimitations: This register completes local source-context field extraction only; it does not complete local review, independent fresh review or reviewed artifact promotion.
Several queued source lines contain lineage or title mismatches and must be resolved before artifact fill.
Publisher access limits and PDF/manual-review requirements are preserved as boundaries rather than converted into evidence claims.
No row authorizes calibrated prediction, individual advice, intervention ranking, clinical-validity claims or individual death-date output.

sourceAccessNotes: PubMed records were checked through NCBI source metadata; mismatched PMID rows are explicitly blocked for domain-claim use until source-resolution.
Official NICE, CDC, WHO and NEI pages are used as source-context anchors only; they are not treated as calibrated model evidence.
The AAO-HNS publisher page for sudden hearing loss returned access-forbidden in automated checks, so the row remains route-context only pending manual access.
The JCIH 2019 Executive Summary PDF was accessible and its EHDI benchmark language was extracted into bounded source-context fields.

extractedRows.sourceTitle: Guidelines for the Management of Severe Traumatic Brain Injury, Fourth Edition

extractedRows.endpointDefinition: Severe TBI care endpoints include mortality, intracranial pressure risk, cerebral perfusion status, neurologic outcome and transition into rehabilitation or long-term care.
